capabilities: Trigger an @ autocomplete that searches note titles and full note content
Insert wikilinks with sentence-bounded aliases for content matches
Preview the full rendered note in a side detail panel
Highlight matched keywords in results and previews
Rebuild the search index live as notes are created, edited, renamed, or deleted
disambiguation: Not social @-mentions of users; the @ trigger autocompletes links to notes by title or content.
extras: Some UI strings are in Chinese (e.g. 标题/正文 chips, relative dates like 今天); the plugin is IME-aware for Chinese pinyin input.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in [[ autocomplete only matches note titles, and even then only by fuzzy title match.
motivation: The author had hundreds of timestamped notes like 250727_095442.md whose titles reveal nothing, so lookup had to happen by content.
problem: Obsidian's built-in [[ autocomplete only fuzzy-matches note titles, so finding notes by their content is impossible, especially with timestamped filenames.
summary: At-mention autocomplete that full-text searches vault notes and inserts wikilinks with rendered previews, sentence aliases, and title-first matching.
